subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` and the optional `parentPeer` parameter on the public inbound-envelope SDK helper for this Google Chat DM thread-session feature?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but the config name/scope and SDK helper signature become public contracts that need maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Shape After Proof
options.body: Accept the config and SDK shape once the baseline hashes and current-head Google Chat proof are added.

options.title: Keep Routing Local
options.body: Keep the Google Chat config option but avoid expanding the public SDK helper unless a broader plugin contract is approved.

options.title: Consolidate Thread Work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle one canonical Google Chat thread-session direction with the older overlapping PR and broader issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Shape After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the config and SDK shape once the baseline hashes and current-head Google Chat proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the SDK, routing, and Google Chat delivery surfaces involved in the product/API decision.
